objections.claim: Unrestricted server-side fetching of user-supplied URLs permits server-side request forgery and returns the fetched data to the caller. A human must resolve the permitted destination boundary before build.
objections.evidence: HOW explicitly chooses fetch(userUrl), no allow-list, and streams the body back in the API response.
objections.predicted_consequence: A caller can submit an internal or loopback HTTP URL reachable by the backend and receive its response body, exposing services unavailable directly to the caller.
